steps.name: interact
steps.expr: document.querySelector('#fig-bert-btns [data-m=qa]').click(); document.querySelector('#dial-knob [data-k=everything]').click(); const i=document.getElementById('live-tok-word'); i.value='tokenization'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const s=document.querySelector('#zs-pick select'); s.value='politics'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'fig-bert:'+document.getElementById('fig-bert-note').textContent.slice(0,40)+' | knob:'+document.getElementById('dial-knob-stats').textContent.slice(0,40)+' | tok:'+document.getElementById('live-wp-longest').textContent+' | zs:'+document.getElementById('zs-pick-acc').textContent

steps.name: tokParity
steps.expr: const ck=D.tok.encodeCheck; const w=document.getElementById('live-tok-word'), n=document.getElementById('live-tok-n'); n.value=300; let bad=[]; for (const e of ck){ w.value=e.word; w.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const g=id=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#'+id+' .tok')].map(t=>t.textContent); const b=g('live-bpe'), r=g('live-wp-replay'), l=g('live-wp-longest'); if (b.join(' ')!==e.bpe.join(' ')) bad.push('bpe '+e.word+': '+b.join(' ')+' vs '+e.bpe.join(' ')); if (r.join(' ')!==e.replay.join(' ')) bad.push('replay '+e.word+': '+r.join(' ')+' vs '+e.replay.join(' ')); if (l.join(' ')!==e.longest.join(' ')) bad.push('longest '+e.word+': '+l.join(' ')+' vs '+e.longest.join(' ')); } return bad.length? bad.join(' || ') : 'all '+ck.length+' words match python'
